I looked at the focused edit window, and it's perfectly clear — the pop-up puts the title and description front and center with everything else dimmed, so there's no mistaking what I'm changing. It works fine.

Between the two, though, I still lean toward editing right inside the card. Since I'm usually just nudging a title or trimming a description, having the pop-up appear feels like a slightly bigger deal than the little fix actually is. Editing in place keeps me in my list and feels lighter.

That said, either one does the job for me — I can edit the title and description and save, which is what matters. So if there's a reason the focused window works better for you technically, I won't fight it. My pick is the in-card editing (version A), with the pop-up as a fine second choice.
